DQ001.description: No duplicate active belongs_to edges per scheme (source_entity_id should be single-valued for belongs_to)

DQ002.description: No duplicate active manages edges per scheme (target_entity_id should be single-valued for manages — grouping by the correct, target side; see services/entity_reconciliation.py's documented incident about grouping manages by source instead)

DQ003.description: Every scheme_plan entity has an active has_plan edge pointing to it

DQ004.description: Active scheme entities missing an active manages edge (AMC unresolved)

DQ005.description: Active scheme entities missing an active belongs_to edge (category unresolved)

DQ006.description: Relationship completeness — fraction of active scheme entities with both a manages and a belongs_to edge

DQ007.description: Identifier mapping coverage — fraction of scheme_plan entities with at least one financial_entity_identifier row

DQ008.description: NAV freshness — fraction of schemes that were trading within the last 90 days (latest_nav_date) whose NAV is nonetheless more than 4 days stale. Restricted to recently-active schemes, not all is_active=TRUE schemes — see run_dataquality_eval.py's _check_nav_freshness docstring for the 2026-07-13 incident where scoring against all 'active' schemes produced a permanent 77% false-positive rate from long-dormant/closed-ended funds mfapi.in still lists but hasn't updated in over a year.

DQ009.description: Sync freshness — fraction of active schemes the daily sync hasn't attempted (last_attempt_at) in the last 30 hours (one daily cron cycle, see infra/cloudformation/mf-nav-sync.yaml, plus buffer). Deliberately uses last_attempt_at, not last_success_at — see run_dataquality_eval.py's _check_sync_freshness docstring for why checking last_success_at produced a 77% false-positive rate (it's only stamped on sync_status='success', not on the equally-legitimate 'no new data available' outcome).
